Br.</ls> .²6 To acknowledge, regard. .²7 To request, ask. .²8 To be favourable. .²9 To try to make favourable. .²10 To assent or consent. --{%<ab>pass.</ab>%} .²1 To be wished or liked. .²2 To be asked, or requested. .²3 To be prescribed or laid down; हस्तच्छेदनमिष्यते <ls>Ms. 8. 322</ls>; त्रिरात्रं दशरात्रं वा शावमाशौचमिष्यते <ls>Y. 3. 18</ls>. .²4 To be approved, accepted, or regarded as जम्भो दन्तेऽपि चेष्यते <ls>Trik.</ls> --II. €4 <ab>P.</ab> (इष्यति इयेष एषिष्यति, एषितुम्) .²1 To move; to cause to move; केनेषितं पतति प्रेषितं मनः <ls>Ken. 1</ls>. येनषिता वागसवश्चरन्ति <ls>Bhāg. 11. 28. 35</ls>. .²2 To let fly, cast, throw. .²3 To raise (as oneʼs voice). .²4 To sprinkle. --III. €9 <ab>P.</ab> (इष्णाति) .²1 To cause to move quickly, let fly, cast. .²2 To fly off, escape. .²3 To strike, smite; न वेद खं गां च परिश्रमेषितः <ls>Bhāg. 12. 9. 16</ls>. .²4 To impel, urge, incite, animate, promote. .²5 To perform frequently; इष्णाति वैष्णवो व्रतम् --IV. €1 <ab>U.</ab> (एषति-ते, ऐषीत्--ऐषिष्ट) To go, move.

इष् {%a.%} .²1 Speedy, going quickly. .²2 Wishing, desirous. {%f.%} <ab>Ved.</ab> .²1 A draught, refreshment, food; वनस्पतीनोषधीश्च ससर्जोर्जमिषं विभुः <ls>Bhāg. 6. 4. 8</ls>. .²2 Libation; नम ऊर्ज इषे त्रय्याः पतये यज्ञरेतसे <ls>Bhāg. 4. 24. 38</ls>. .²3 Strength, power, sap, freshness. .²4 Comfort; increase. .²5 Affluence. .²6 Refreshing waters of the sky. .²7 Wish.
